import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd()
for n in ['PROOF.md','REVIEW.md','DORMANT-BRIEF.md']:
 s=(p/n).read_text(); print(n,len(s),'characters',hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest())
for n in ['review.json','source-map.json','access-search-inventory.json','resource-inventory.json','TERMINAL-EXCLUSIONS.json']:json.loads((p/n).read_text())
a=json.loads((p/'inputs/accepted57-scopes.json').read_text())['records'];b=json.loads((p/'inputs/prior39-scopes.json').read_text())
records=[{'group':'current57','id':x['mathdb_id'],'title':x['title'],'assessment':'No matching PageRank fixed-outside-row optimization endpoint in supplied exact statement/scope; no certificate body audit.'} for x in a]
records += [{'group':'prior39','number':x['number'],'title':x['title'],'assessment':'Distinct supplied source-question endpoint; no matching uniform PageRank optimizer/inlink conclusion or demonstrated subsumer.'} for x in b['prior30']+b['next9']]
obj={'scope_count':len(records),'counts':[len(a),len(b['prior30'])+len(b['next9'])],'comparison':'Personal statement/scope comparison, not automated semantic proof or worldwide prior-art screen','closest_overlap':'Markov information, resistance and spectral results have different objects/objectives/quantifiers; no target bridge established','records':records}
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'scope-inventory.json'],input=json.dumps(obj,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
raw=(p/'inputs/original316846.raw.jsonl').read_bytes();prov=json.loads((p/'inputs/provenance316846.json').read_text());print('Raw hash matches supplied provenance:',hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==prov['raw_sha256'])
print('Documentary JSON parsed; scope counts',obj['counts'],'; no mathematical checker or test executed.')
